title: Unsupervised learning underdeveloped relative to supervised learning
description: Unsupervised learning catalysed the revival of deep learning but has since been overshadowed by the successes of purely supervised learning, even though human and animal learning is largely unsupervised.
canonical_description: unsupervised learning lags behind supervised learning in performance

evidence.anchor: overshadowed by the successes of purely supervised learning
evidence.quote: Unsupervised learning <sup>91–98</sup> had a catalytic effect in reviving interest in deep learning, but has since been overshadowed by the successes of purely supervised learning.
